literal: On yiyou day, Special Advance Yuan Shao was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Bingzhou Inspector Duan Shao was made Right Vice Director.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Yuan Shao, Special Advance, was appointed left vice director of the Masters of Writing, and Duan Shao, inspector of Bingzhou, right vice director.

literal: On bingxu day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Tuyuhun sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: On renchen day, the Chancellor's Office was abolished; the Cavalry Bureau and External Military Bureau were each retained as separate offices to handle confidential matters.
idiomatic: On renchen day the chancellor's office was abolished, but the cavalry and external military bureaus were each kept as separate secretariats to handle confidential affairs.

literal: In the eleventh month, Emperor Wen of Zhou led his forces to Shancheng, sent cavalry north across the river, and reached Jianzhou.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Emperor Wen of Zhou led his army to Shancheng, sent cavalry north across the Yellow River, and reached Jianzhou.

literal: On jiayin day, Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingyin day, the emperor took the field in person and encamped east of the city.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the emperor took command in person and encamped east of the city.

literal: When Emperor Wen of Zhou heard how stern and splendid the emperor's array was, he sighed and said, "Gao Huan is not dead after all.
idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Zhou saw how stern and splendid the emperor's battle array was, he sighed and said, "Gao Huan is not dead after all.

literal: " And he withdrew his army.
idiomatic: " And he withdrew his army.

literal: On gengwu day, the emperor returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the emperor returned to the palace.

literal: In the twelfth month, on dingchou day, Rouran and the Kumo Xi both sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingchou day, Rouran and the Kumo Xi both sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On xinchou day, the emperor arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: In the second year, on dingwei of the first spring month, Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the second year, on dingwei of the first spring month, Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On xinhai day, rites were performed at the Round Mound, with Emperor Shenwu enshrined as associate.
idiomatic: On xinhai day rites were performed at the Round Mound, with Emperor Shenwu enshrined as associate.

literal: On guihai day, the emperor personally plowed the sacred field in the eastern suburbs.
idiomatic: On guihai day the emperor personally plowed the sacred field in the eastern suburbs.

literal: On yiyou day, former Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Yuan Shibao and General-in-Ordinary Attendant Gentleman-in-Attendant Peng Guiping plotted rebellion and were spared death, being sent to the frontier instead.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Yuan Shibao, former attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gate, and Peng Guiping, general-in-ordinary attendant gentleman-in-attendant, plotted rebellion; they were spared death and sent to the frontier.

literal: Rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
idiomatic: Rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

literal: On jiaxu day, the emperor went boating east of the city.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the emperor went boating east of the city.

literal: In the second month, on renchen day, Grand Commandant Peng Le plotted rebellion and was executed.
idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen day, Grand Commandant Peng Le plotted rebellion and was executed.

literal: On renyin day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On renyin day Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the third month, on bingwu day, Prince of Xiangcheng Gao You died.
idiomatic: In the third month, on bingwu day, Prince of Xiangcheng Gao You died.

literal: On jiwei day, an edict made Xiao Yi, holding provisional authority for Liang, Minister of State with the yellow battle-axe, established the Liang court, and entrusted him with all government under provisional authority.
idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict made Xiao Yi, holding provisional authority for Liang, minister of state with the yellow battle-axe, established the Liang court, and entrusted him with all government under provisional authority.

literal: Li Jingsheng, Inspector of Jiaozhou of Liang, Ma Songren, Inspector of Liangzhou, Xia Hou Zhenqia, Inspector of Yizhou, Li Han, Inspector of Xinzhou, and others all led their provinces to submit.
idiomatic: Li Jingsheng, inspector of Jiaozhou of Liang, Ma Songren, inspector of Liangzhou, Xia Hou Zhenqia, inspector of Yizhou, Li Han, inspector of Xinzhou, and others all led their provinces to submit.

literal: On gengshen day, Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.

literal: In the fourth month, on renchen day, King Xiao Yi of Liang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renchen day, King Xiao Yi of Liang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingxu day, Hezhou Inspector Husi Xian attacked and captured Liang's Liyang garrison.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Hezhou Inspector Husi Xian attacked and captured Liang's Liyang garrison.

literal: On dinghai day, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month, Hou Jing deposed Emperor Jianwen of Liang and set up Xiao Dong as ruler.
idiomatic: That month Hou Jing deposed Emperor Jianwen of Liang and set up Xiao Dong as ruler.

literal: In the sixth month, on gengwu day, former Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was made Grand Commandant.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengwu day, former Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was made Grand Commandant.

literal: In the seventh month, on renshen day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renshen day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On guiyou day, Xingtai secretary Xing Jingyuan broke Liang's Long'an garrison and captured its garrison commander Li Luowen.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Xingtai secretary Xing Jingyuan broke Liang's Long'an garrison and captured its garrison commander Li Luowen.

literal: On jimao day, Xianyang Hall was renamed Zhaoyang Hall.
idiomatic: On jimao day Xianyang Hall was renamed Zhaoyang Hall.

literal: In the ninth month, on renshen day, an edict freed all entertainers, military colonists, herders, and bond servants of miscellaneous labor and made them common households.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, an edict freed all entertainers, military colonists, herders, and bond servants of miscellaneous labor and made them common households.

literal: On guisi day, the emperor went to Zhao and Ding provinces and then to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On guisi day the emperor went to Zhao and Ding provinces and then to Jinyang.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen day, the Xuanguang, Jianshi, Jiafu, and Renshou halls were begun.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen day, construction began on the Xuanguang, Jianshi, Jiafu, and Renshou halls.

literal: On gengshen day, Xiao Yi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Xiao Yi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On dingmao day, the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenxiang entered the ancestral temple.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenxiang entered the ancestral temple.

literal: In the eleventh month, Hou Jing deposed the Liang ruler, usurped the throne at Jiankang, and styled himself Han.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Hou Jing deposed the Liang ruler, usurped the throne at Jiankang, and styled himself Han.

literal: In the twelfth month, the Prince of Zhongshan died.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Prince of Zhongshan died.

literal: In the third year, on bingchen of the first spring month, the emperor personally campaigned against the Kumo Xi in Da Commandery, routed them utterly, and took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, distributing rewards to officers and soldiers in varying measure.
idiomatic: In the third year, on bingchen of the first spring month, the emperor personally campaigned against the Kumo Xi in Da Commandery, routed them utterly, and took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, distributing rewards to officers and soldiers in varying measure.

literal: Captives of the Xi were assigned to Shandong as common people.
idiomatic: Captives of the Xi were assigned to Shandong as common people.

literal: In the second month, Rouran ruler Anagui was broken by the Turks; Anagui killed himself, and his crown prince Anluochen, his cousin from the father's side Dengzhu Houli, and Dengzhu's son Kuti all led their bands to flee and submit.
idiomatic: In the second month Rouran ruler Anagui was broken by the Turks; Anagui killed himself, and his crown prince Anluochen, his cousin from the father's side Dengzhu Houli, and Dengzhu's son Kuti all led their bands to flee and submit.

literal: The remaining Rouran set up Dengzhu's second son Tiepo as ruler.
idiomatic: The remaining Rouran set up Dengzhu's second son Tiepo as ruler.

literal: On xinchou day, the Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the Khitan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the third month, on wuzi day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Commissioner with Full Powers, Grand Commander of the Southern Route; Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang was made Commissioner with Full Powers, Grand Commander of the Southeastern Route; and with Xingtai Xin Shu they led armies south to attack.
idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, inspector of Sizhou, was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southern route; Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southeastern route; and with Xingtai Xin Shu they led armies south to attack.

literal: On guisi day, an edict advanced King Xiao Yi of Liang to Emperor of Liang.
idiomatic: On guisi day an edict advanced King Xiao Yi of Liang to Emperor of Liang.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen day, Xin Shu of the Southeastern Route Xingtai presented the Imperial Seal of Transmission at Guangling.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen day, Xin Shu of the southeastern route Xingtai presented the Imperial Seal of Transmission at Guangling.

literal: On jiashen day, Minister of Personnel Yang Yin was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Minister of Personnel Yang Yin was made right vice director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On bingshen day, the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue and the others returned from campaign.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue and the others returned from campaign.

literal: On dingwei day, the emperor arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: On yimao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On yimao day the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, the emperor traveled from Bingzhou to Lishi.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, the emperor traveled from Bingzhou to Lishi.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yiwei day, he reached Huanglu Ridge and there began the Great Wall, running north to Shegan Garrison for more than four hundred li and establishing thirty-six garrisons.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yiwei day, he reached Huanglu Ridge and there began the Great Wall, running north to Shegan Garrison for more than four hundred li and establishing thirty-six garrisons.

literal: In the eleventh month, on xinsi day, King Xiao Yi of Liang took the throne at Jiangling as Emperor Yuan and sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinsi day, King Xiao Yi of Liang took the throne at Jiangling as Emperor Yuan and sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the twelfth month, on renzi day, the emperor returned to the palace.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renzi day, the emperor returned to the palace.

literal: On wuwu day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the fourth year, on bingzi of the first spring month, the Shan Hu besieged Lishi.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on bingzi of the first spring month, the Shan Hu besieged Lishi.

literal: On wuyin day, the emperor campaigned against them; before he arrived the Hu had already fled, and he then inspected the Sandui garrison, held a great hunt, and returned.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the emperor campaigned against them; before he arrived the Hu had already fled, and he then inspected the Sandui garrison, held a great hunt, and returned.

literal: On wuyin day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jichou day, new coin was cast with the inscription "Changping Wuzhu."
idiomatic: On jichou day new coin was cast with the inscription "Changping Wuzhu."

literal: In the second month, Rouran ruler Tiepo's father Dengzhu and son Kuti were sent back north.
idiomatic: In the second month Rouran ruler Tiepo's father Dengzhu and son Kuti were sent back north.

literal: Tiepo was soon killed by the Khitan; the people again set up Dengzhu as ruler, but he was then killed by tribal elders including Afuti; the people again set up Kuti as ruler.
idiomatic: Tiepo was soon killed by the Khitan; the people again set up Dengzhu as ruler, but he was then killed by tribal elders including Afuti; the people again set up Kuti as ruler.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu day, the emperor returned to the palace.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu day, the emperor returned to the palace.

literal: On wuwu day, a great sound like thunder came from the southwest.
idiomatic: On wuwu day a great sound like thunder came from the southwest.

literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the emperor reviewed troops and hunted at Mount Linlu.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the emperor reviewed troops and hunted at Mount Linlu.

literal: On wuzi day, he returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On wuzi day he returned to the palace.

literal: In the ninth month, the Khitan raided the frontier.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the Khitan raided the frontier.

literal: On renwu day, the emperor toured Ji, Ding, You, and An and then marched north to campaign against the Khitan.
idiomatic: On renwu day the emperor toured Ji, Ding, You, and An and then marched north to campaign against the Khitan.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou day, the emperor reached Pingzhou and then took the western route toward Changcheng.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou day, the emperor reached Pingzhou and then took the western route toward Changcheng.

literal: An edict ordered Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang to lead five thousand picked cavalry by the eastern route toward Qingshan.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang to lead five thousand picked cavalry by the eastern route toward Qingshan.

literal: On xinchou day, he reached Bailang Fortress.
idiomatic: On xinchou day he reached Bailang Fortress.

literal: On renyin day, he passed Changli Fortress.
idiomatic: On renyin day he passed Changli Fortress.

literal: Again an edict ordered Prince of Ande Han Gui to lead four thousand picked cavalry eastward to cut off the Khitan line of retreat.
idiomatic: Again an edict ordered Prince of Ande Han Gui to lead four thousand picked cavalry eastward to cut off the Khitan line of retreat.

literal: On guimao day, he reached the Yangshi River, marched day and night at forced speed, and fell upon the Khitan by surprise.
idiomatic: On guimao day he reached the Yangshi River, marched day and night at forced speed, and fell upon the Khitan by surprise.

literal: On jiachen day, the emperor himself crossed the mountain ridge ahead of the soldiers, directed the assault, and routed them utterly, taking more than a hundred thousand captives and several hundred thousand head of mixed livestock.
idiomatic: On jiachen day the emperor himself crossed the mountain ridge ahead of the soldiers, directed the assault, and routed them utterly, taking more than a hundred thousand captives and several hundred thousand head of mixed livestock.

literal: Pan Xiang also routed a separate Khitan division at Qingshan.
idiomatic: Pan Xiang also routed a separate Khitan division at Qingshan.

literal: All captives taken were distributed among the various provinces.
idiomatic: All captives taken were distributed among the various provinces.

literal: On this campaign the emperor went bareheaded and bare-chested, marching without rest day and night for more than a thousand li, eating only meat and drinking only water, his martial spirit growing ever fiercer.
idiomatic: On this campaign the emperor went bareheaded and bare-chested, marching without rest day and night for more than a thousand li, eating only meat and drinking only water, his martial spirit growing ever fiercer.

literal: On dingwei day, he reached Yingzhou.
idiomatic: On dingwei day he reached Yingzhou.

literal: On dingsi day, he ascended Jieshi Mountain and looked out over the Eastern Sea.
idiomatic: On dingsi day he ascended Jieshi Mountain and looked out over the Eastern Sea.

literal: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, the emperor left Pingzhou and went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, the emperor left Pingzhou and went to Jinyang.

literal: In the intercalary month, on renyin day, the Emperor of Liang sent envoys on a formal visit.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renyin day, the Emperor of Liang sent envoys on a formal visit.

literal: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, the Turks again attacked Rouran, and Rouran fled south with the whole nation.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, the Turks again attacked Rouran, and Rouran fled south with the whole nation.

literal: On guihai day, the emperor marched north from Jinyang to campaign against the Turks and receive Rouran.
idiomatic: On guihai day the emperor marched north from Jinyang to campaign against the Turks and receive Rouran.

literal: He deposed their ruler Kuti, set up Anagui's son Anluochen as ruler, and settled him at Mayi River, supplying grain rations and silk.
idiomatic: He deposed their ruler Kuti, set up Anagui's son Anluochen as ruler, and settled him at Mayi River, supplying grain rations and silk.

literal: He personally pursued the Turks to Shuozhou; the Turks asked to surrender, and he granted it and returned.
idiomatic: He personally pursued the Turks to Shuozhou; the Turks asked to surrender, and he granted it and returned.

literal: From then on tribute followed in succession.
idiomatic: From then on tribute followed in succession.

literal: In the fifth year, on guisi of the first spring month, the emperor campaigned against the Shan Hu by the Lishi route.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on guisi of the first spring month, the emperor campaigned against the Shan Hu by the Lishi route.

literal: He sent Grand Preceptor Prince of Xianyang Hulü Jin by the Xianzhou route and Prince of Changshan Gao Yan by the Jinzhou route; attacking from both sides they routed the enemy utterly, beheaded tens of thousands, took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, and thereupon pacified Shilou.
idiomatic: He sent Grand Preceptor Prince of Xianyang Hulü Jin by the Xianzhou route and Prince of Changshan Gao Yan by the Jinzhou route; attacking from both sides they routed the enemy utterly, beheaded tens of thousands, took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, and thereupon pacified Shilou.

literal: Shilou was utterly perilous; since the Wei dynasty none had been able to reach it.
idiomatic: Shilou was utterly perilous; since the Wei dynasty none had been able to reach it.

literal: Thereupon the Shan Hu near and far all submitted in awe.
idiomatic: Thereupon the Shan Hu near and far all submitted in awe.

literal: That month Emperor Wen of Zhou deposed the Western Wei ruler and set up Yuwen Kuo as Emperor Gong.
idiomatic: That month Emperor Wen of Zhou deposed the Western Wei ruler and set up Yuwen Kuo as Emperor Gong.

literal: In the third month, Rouran's Anluochen rebelled; the emperor personally campaigned against him, routed him utterly, and Anluochen and his son fled north.
idiomatic: In the third month Rouran's Anluochen rebelled; the emperor personally campaigned against him, routed him utterly, and Anluochen and his son fled north.

literal: Grand Guardian Heba Ren was stripped of rank for violating command.
idiomatic: Grand Guardian Heba Ren was stripped of rank for violating command.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, Rouran raided Sizhou.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Rouran raided Sizhou.

literal: On dingsi day, the emperor campaigned against them from Jinyang; at Hundred Melon Mound in Hengzhou the enemy cavalry fled.
idiomatic: On dingsi day the emperor campaigned against them from Jinyang; at Hundred Melon Mound in Hengzhou the enemy cavalry fled.

literal: The main army had already returned when the emperor, leading a little more than a thousand cavalry of his own, encountered a separate Rouran force of tens of thousands that closed in from all sides.
idiomatic: The main army had already returned when the emperor, leading a little more than a thousand cavalry of his own, encountered a separate Rouran force of tens of thousands that closed in from all sides.

literal: The emperor's bearing was perfectly calm; he traced the situation with his finger, the enemy ranks broke apart, and he broke through at a gallop.
idiomatic: The emperor's bearing was perfectly calm; he traced the situation with his finger, the enemy ranks broke apart, and he broke through at a gallop.

literal: The enemy then retreated; he pursued them, and corpses lay fallen for twenty li; he took Anluochen's wife and children and more than thirty thousand captives.
idiomatic: The enemy then retreated; he pursued them, and corpses lay fallen for twenty li; he took Anluochen's wife and children and more than thirty thousand captives.
